pyqgis_plugin.name: Routing Plan
pyqgis_plugin.description: Turn-by-turn navigation and route planning using the Valhalla routing engine. Load waypoints from CSV, Excel, GeoJSON, KML, or QGIS layers. Compute routes with turn-by-turn directions like Google Maps. Supports route optimization, multiple costing modes (auto, truck, bus, taxi, motorcycle, bicycle, pedestrian), and avoid options (highways, tolls, ferries, unpaved). Export routes to HTML, GeoJSON, KML, or GeoPackage. Client-side Indonesian maneuver translation for local users. QGIS 4.0 / Qt6 compatible.
pyqgis_plugin.about: QGIS plugin for turn-by-turn navigation and route planning using the Valhalla routing engine. Built for QGIS 4.0+.
